text:
Consumer behavior insights from the feedback:

1. Price Sensitivity: The consumer is highly sensitive to price increases, especially when not accompanied by corresponding quality improvements.
2. Quality Expectations: There is a strong expectation for consistent or improving product quality over time. A perceived decline in quality triggers a search for alternatives.
3. Value-Driven Loyalty: Brand loyalty is conditional and transactional. It is maintained only as long as the perceived value (quality relative to price) remains favorable.
4. Switching Behavior: When value propositions deteriorate, consumers are willing and able to switch to competitors, even after years of patronage.
5. Search for Alternatives: Dissatisfied consumers actively explore other brands and are motivated by tangible benefits such as better taste and lower cost.
